versions.subject: regsvr32 Anomalies
versions.detection:
selection1:
    EventID: 1
    Image: '*\regsvr32.exe'
    CommandLine: '*\Temp\*'
selection2:
    EventID: 1
    Image: '*\regsvr32.exe'
    ParentImage: '*\powershell.exe'
condition: any of them

versions.subject: Regsvr32.exe anomalies (bugfix and new selection)
versions.detection:
# Loads from Temp folder
selection1:
    EventID: 1
    Image: '*\regsvr32.exe'
    CommandLine: '*\Temp\*'
# Loaded by powershell
selection2:
    EventID: 1
    Image: '*\regsvr32.exe'
    ParentImage: '*\powershell.exe'
# Regsvr32.exe used with http(s) address
selection3:
    EventID: 1
    Image: '*\regsvr32.exe'
    Commandline: '/i:http'
condition: selection1 or selection2 or selection3
versions.spl: (EventID=1 Image="*\\regsvr32.exe" CommandLine="*\\Temp\*") OR (EventID=1 Image="*\\regsvr32.exe" ParentImage="*\\powershell.exe") OR (EventID=1 Image="*\\regsvr32.exe" Commandline="/i:http")

versions.subject: Improved regsvr32.exe whitelisting bypass rule thanks to Nick Carr https://twitter.com/ItsReallyNick/status/872409920938946560

selection1:

    Image: '*\regsvr32.exe'

    Image: '*\regsvr32.exe'
    ParentImage: '*\powershell.exe'
# Regsvr32.exe used with http(s) address

    Image: '*\regsvr32.exe'

        - '*/i:ftp* scrobj.dll'
